newsitem.title: FRANCE: French to pay at least 20 bln Ffr less in tax.
newsitem.headline: French to pay at least 20 bln Ffr less in tax.

text.p: French government spokesman Alain Lamassoure said the French would pay at least a net 20 billion francs less in taxes next year as a result of the government's overhaul of the tax system.
"The French will pay at least 20 billion francs less in tax ...in 1997 than in 1996," he told radio station RTL.
Lamassoure, who is also budget minister, said the net tax cut figure reflected a raft of new government tax measures announced for 1997 aimed at stimulating the economy.
The government said in a statement on Thursday that it was cutting income taxes next year by 25 billion francs in an effort to stimulate the economy.
But once additional welfare taxes were taken into account, the government said then that the reforms would produce a net tax cut of 18 billion francs.
